excerpt: The AI Compute Gateway - One API. Every AI Model. Contribute to radium0090/Compute-Gateway development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
One API. Every AI model.

RAX Compute Gateway is an open-source AI Compute Gateway. It gives applications one stable, OpenAI-compatible API for multiple model providers while centralizing routing, authentication, retries, limits, and telemetry.

Application -> RAX Compute Gateway -> OpenAI | Anthropic | Gemini | future providers

Status

RAX Compute Gateway v0.2.0 adds the operator console, one-command self-hosted quickstart, and the public, abuse-resistant hosted evaluation described below. Release artifacts include a signed multi-architecture image, Helm chart, OpenAPI contract, checksums, SBOM, and provenance. The documents in this repository remain normative unless an accepted Architecture Decision Record (ADR) supersedes them.

MVP capabilities

  • POST /v1/chat/completions, including streaming
  • OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini adapters
  • Stable public model aliases and explicit provider models
  • Deterministic routing, fallback, timeout, and retry policies
  • RAX Compute Gateway API keys and bring-your-own-provider-key (BYOK) operation
  • PostgreSQL metadata, optional Redis coordination, and stateless gateway nodes
  • OpenTelemetry traces and metrics plus structured, redacted logs
  • Docker Compose for local use and Kubernetes manifests/Helm for production
  • TypeScript and Python SDKs generated from the public contract

Non-goals for the original MVP include tool calling and structured outputs, a hosted billing system, a marketplace, GPU scheduling, multimodal generation, and autonomous quality-based model selection. The operator console and hosted evaluation are narrowly scoped post-MVP additions governed by accepted ADRs.

Choose your first run

60-second hosted trial

Open api.rax-digital.com/demo, verify with GitHub, and copy the generated curl. The complete public path has been verified against the production gateway: claim a key, run the command, and receive a normalized model response.

The service issues a unique API key that expires after five minutes; there is no shared public key in this repository. The trial is intentionally limited to one low-cost model, non-streaming calls, small input/output budgets, one concurrent request, per-account cooldown, and a global daily budget. See hosted demo design and operation.

The hosted service is for evaluation only. Applications should self-host or obtain a normal customer key rather than depend on trial availability.

5–10 minute self-hosted start

Prerequisites: Docker 26+ with Docker Compose, curl, and an OpenAI API key for the first request. A fork is needed only when contributing code; to try the gateway, clone the upstream repository and run one command:

git clone https://github.com/radium0090/Compute-Gateway.git
cd Compute-Gateway
sh scripts/quickstart.sh

The script creates a private .env, generates local gateway secrets, prompts for the provider key without echoing it, starts PostgreSQL, Redis, telemetry, and the gateway, provisions a local client key, and prints the first model response. It never sends the OpenAI key anywhere except the configured OpenAI endpoint. Stop the stack with docker compose down.

A successful run ends with a normalized JSON chat response and a local rcg_dev_... credential shown once. If the provider rejects the final request, the local stack remains running for diagnosis; check provider billing/model access, update .env, and rerun the script.

To understand or run each operation manually instead:

cp .env.example .env
# Replace the fake RCG secrets and OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.
docker compose up --build --wait
docker compose exec postgres psql -U rcg -d compute_gateway -c \
  "INSERT INTO tenants (id, name, status) VALUES ('123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000', 'local', 'active') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"
RCG_API_KEY="$(docker compose run --rm gateway keys create \
  --tenant-id 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000 \
  --name local-app --environment dev --models 'rax/*' --allow-streaming)"
export RCG_API_KEY
test -n "$RCG_API_KEY"

The key command emits the new credential once; command substitution keeps it out of the terminal and stores it in the current shell. Keep it out of shell history, source control, logs, and URLs.

Compose supplies PostgreSQL and Redis. Outside production, running the gateway without RCG_REDIS_URL uses process-local limits and circuit state; every production replica requires Redis coordination and fails startup if it is not configured.

Send a request:

curl http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RCG_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rax/fast",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello from RAX Compute Gateway"}]
  }'

RAX Compute Gateway accepts the OpenAI client by changing its base URL:

import os

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["RCG_API_KEY"],
    base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="rax/fast",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)

Operator console (v0.2)

Set RCG_ADMIN_ENABLED=true, configure the exact RCG_ADMIN_ORIGIN, and use a dedicated RCG_ADMIN_SESSION_PEPPER. After migrations, create the first administrator with a temporary password supplied on standard input:

printf '%s\n' "$RCG_ADMIN_TEMPORARY_PASSWORD" | docker compose run --rm -T gateway \
  admins create --email owner@example.com --display-name 'Gateway Owner'

Open http://localhost:8080/admin/. The temporary password must be replaced at first login. The console manages tenants and one-time-display API keys and shows bounded service/activity metadata. It never exposes provider credentials, password/session hashes, API-key hashes, prompts, or completions.

Documentation

Runnable curl, Node.js, and Python examples are included for a locally running gateway.

Development contract

The keywords MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, and MAY are used as defined by RFC 2119. Implementation work should follow this precedence order:

  1. Accepted ADRs
  2. API and security contracts
  3. MVP acceptance criteria
  4. Architecture and operational guidance
  5. Roadmap ideas

If documents conflict, open an issue and resolve it with an ADR before merging behavior that changes the public contract.

Community

Use GitHub Issues for bugs and scoped features, Discussions for questions and design exploration, and pull requests for reviewed changes. Please read CONTRIBUTING before submitting code.

You do not need to fork merely to run the gateway. To contribute, first fork the repository, clone your fork, create a feature branch, and open a pull request as described in the contribution guide.

content_html_zh:
一个 API。 每个人工智能模型。

RAX 计算网关是一个开源 AI 计算网关。 它为应用程序提供了一种适用于多个模型提供商的稳定、兼容 OpenAI 的 API，同时集中路由、身份验证、重试、限制和遥测。

Application -> RAX Compute Gateway -> OpenAI | Anthropic | Gemini | future providers

地位

RAX 计算网关 v0.2.0 添加了操作员控制台、单命令自托管快速入门以及公共防滥用托管评估（如下所述）。 发布工件包括签名的多架构映像、Helm 图表、OpenAPI 合约、校验和、SBOM 和出处。 此存储库中的文档仍然是规范性的，除非已接受的架构决策记录 (ADR) 取代它们。

MVP 能力

  • POST /v1/chat/completions，包括流媒体
  • OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Gemini 适配器
  • 稳定的公共模型别名和显式提供者模型
  • 确定性路由、回退、超时和重试策略
  • RAX 计算网关 API 密钥和自带提供商密钥 (BYOK) 操作
  • PostgreSQL 元数据、可选的 Redis 协调和无状态网关节点
  • OpenTelemetry 跟踪和指标以及结构化、经过编辑的日志
  • Docker Compose 用于本地使用，Kubernetes 清单/Helm 用于生产
  • 从公共合约生成的 TypeScript 和 Python SDK

原始 MVP 的非目标包括工具调用和结构化输出、托管计费系统、市场、GPU 调度、多模式生成和基于质量的自主模型选择。 操作员控制台和托管评估是范围狭窄的 MVP 后添加内容，受公认的 ADR 管辖。

选择您的第一次运行

60 秒托管试用

打开 api.rax-digital.com/demo，使用 GitHub 进行验证，然后复制生成的curl。 完整的公共路径已针对生产网关进行了验证：声明密钥、运行命令并接收规范化模型响应。

该服务颁发一个唯一的 API 密钥，该密钥会在五分钟后过期；此存储库中没有共享公钥。 该试验有意限制为一种低成本模型、非流式调用、较小的输入/输出预算、一个并发请求、每个帐户的冷却时间和全局每日预算。 请参阅托管演示设计和操作。

托管服务仅供评估之用。 应用程序应该自行托管或获取正常的客户密钥，而不是依赖于试用版的可用性。

5-10 分钟自托管启动

先决条件：Docker 26+，具有 Docker Compose、curl 和用于第一个请求的 OpenAI API 密钥。 仅在贡献代码时才需要分叉；要尝试网关，请克隆上游存储库并运行一个命令：

git clone https://github.com/radium0090/Compute-Gateway.git
cd Compute-Gateway
sh scripts/quickstart.sh

该脚本创建私有 .env，生成本地网关机密，提示输入提供程序密钥而不回显它，启动 PostgreSQL、Redis、遥测和网关，提供本地客户端密钥，并打印第一个模型响应。 除了配置的 OpenAI 端点之外，它不会将 OpenAI 密钥发送到任何地方。 使用 docker compose down 停止堆栈。

成功的运行以规范化的 JSON 聊天响应和本地 rcg_dev_... 结束。 凭证显示一次。 如果提供者拒绝最终请求，本地堆栈将继续运行以进行诊断；检查提供商计费/模型访问权限，更新 .env，然后重新运行脚本。

要了解或手动运行每个操作：

cp .env.example .env
# Replace the fake RCG secrets and OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.
docker compose up --build --wait
docker compose exec postgres psql -U rcg -d compute_gateway -c \
  "INSERT INTO tenants (id, name, status) VALUES ('123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000', 'local', 'active') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"
RCG_API_KEY="$(docker compose run --rm gateway keys create \
  --tenant-id 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000 \
  --name local-app --environment dev --models 'rax/*' --allow-streaming)"
export RCG_API_KEY
test -n "$RCG_API_KEY"

键命令发出一次新凭证；命令替换将其保留在终端之外并将其存储在当前 shell 中。 使其远离 shell 历史记录、源代码控制、日志和 URL。

Compose 提供 PostgreSQL 和 Redis。 在生产环境之外，在没有 RCG_REDIS_URL 的情况下运行网关会使用进程本地限制和电路状态；每个生产副本都需要 Redis 协调，如果未配置，则启动失败。

发送请求：

curl http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RCG_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rax/fast",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello from RAX Compute Gateway"}]
  }'

RAX 计算网关通过更改其基本 URL 来接受 OpenAI 客户端：

import os

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["RCG_API_KEY"],
    base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="rax/fast",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)

操作员控制台 (v0.2)

设置 RCG_ADMIN_ENABLED=true，配置确切的 RCG_ADMIN_ORIGIN，并使用专用的 RCG_ADMIN_SESSION_PEPPER。 迁移后，使用标准输入上提供的临时密码创建第一个管理员：

printf '%s\n' "$RCG_ADMIN_TEMPORARY_PASSWORD" | docker compose run --rm -T gateway \
  admins create --email owner@example.com --display-name 'Gateway Owner'

打开http://localhost:8080/admin/。首次登录时必须更换临时密码。 该控制台管理租户和一次性显示 API 密钥，并显示有限的服务/活动元数据。 它永远不会暴露提供者凭据、密码/会话哈希、API 密钥哈希、提示或完成。

开发合同

关键字 MUST、MUST NOT、SHOULD 和 MAY 按 RFC 2119 的定义使用。 实施工作应遵循以下优先顺序：

  1. 接受的 ADR
  2. API 和安全合约
  3. MVP 接受标准
  4. 架构和运营指导
  5. 路线图想法

如果文档存在冲突，请提出问题并通过 ADR 解决，然后再合并更改公共合同的行为。

社区

使用 GitHub 问题来查找错误和范围内的功能，使用讨论来查找问题和设计探索，并使用拉取请求来查看已审核的更改。 请在提交代码之前阅读 CONTRIBUTING。

您不需要仅仅为了运行网关而进行分叉。 要做出贡献，首先分叉存储库，克隆您的分叉，创建功能分支，然后按照贡献指南中所述打开拉取请求。
